description: Agent-based, network-embedded simulation of mask adoption dynamics under social influence, information flows, and policy interventions. Persons form a small-world social network, interact in households and locations, receive information from sources, face policy enforcement, and make probabilistic adoption decisions shaped by risk perception, peer norms, costs, and fatigue. A market module handles mask supply and prices.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Construct social network (small-world by default), households, and assign initial neighbor lists.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  build Watts-Strogatz small-world graph with N=population_size, k=average_degree, beta=small_world_rewiring_p
  create households using avg_household_size; assign members and norm_strength ~ TruncNormal(mean=household_norm_strength_mean, sd=household_norm_strength_sd)
  set Person.network_neighbors from graph adjacency
  set Person.household_id from assignment
  create Location instances for households with capacity equal to household size
  create other Locations per counts and capacities
notes: Runs only at initialization.
If network_type != small_world, use corresponding generator (ER or scale-free).

modules.name: InitializationModule
modules.description: Initialize agent attributes (demographics, attitudes, adoption status) using specified distributions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  for each Person:
    sample age_group, income_level, education_level from categorical distributions
    trust_in_authority ~ TruncNormal(trust_distribution_mean, trust_distribution_sd)
    risk_perception ~ TruncNormal(risk_perception_init_mean, risk_perception_init_sd)
    compliance_propensity ~ TruncNormal(compliance_propensity_mean, compliance_propensity_sd)
    social_influence_susceptibility ~ TruncNormal(social_influence_susceptibility_mean, social_influence_susceptibility_sd)
    cost_sensitivity ~ TruncNormal(cost_sensitivity_mean, cost_sensitivity_sd)
    fatigue_level = 0.0
    wearing_mask ~ Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate)
    if wearing_mask: assign mask_type by multinomial weighted by efficacy/cost ratio
    exposure_history = 0
    media_consumption_profile ~ Categorical(media_profile_shares)
    health_state = 'susceptible' (placeholder if disease not modeled)
  seed AdoptionDecision internal state for mask tenure for already wearing agents
notes: Truncate to [0,1] for bounded traits.
Mask type for initial adopters prefers higher efficacy/cost; break ties randomly.

modules.name: InformationBroadcast
modules.description: Broadcasts daily information signals (campaigns and misinformation) affecting perceived risk and trust by media profile.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each media profile:
  construct base message intensity = info_campaign_intensity * policy_visibility_multiplier
  misinfo_draw ~ Bernoulli(misinformation_rate)
  risk_delta_profile = campaign_risk_gain - misinfo_risk_reduction
  trust_delta_profile = campaign_trust_gain - misinfo_trust_erosion
  broadcast per profile deltas
for each Person:
  apply deltas weighted by their media_consumption_profile and source credibility weights
notes: Policy visibility multiplier increases with mandates and enforcement.
Misinformation effect is higher for social media profile.

modules.name: RiskPerceptionUpdate
modules.description: Updates individual risk perception from external prevalence signal and forgetting.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person:
  prev_sig = get_external_prevalence(t)
  rp_new = (1 - forgetting_rate) * risk_perception + prevalence_signal_sensitivity * prev_sig + info.signal_risk_delta(person)
  risk_perception = clamp(rp_new, 0, 1)
notes: external prevalence source can be flat or data-driven.
For data mode, external series provides value; for flat mode, use ext_prev_flat_value.

modules.name: HouseholdInfluence
modules.description: Applies within-household norm pressure on adoption propensity.

notes: Centered at 0.5 so norm pressure is positive if majority wears masks.

modules.name: SocialInfluence
modules.description: Computes peer influence from social network neighbors.

notes: Centered influence to allow dis-adoption if peers mostly unmasked.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Sets policy state over time, adjusts enforcement levels, and signage/fines.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == policy_start_day_1: policy_state = policy_state_1
if t == policy_start_day_2: policy_state = policy_state_2
current_enforcement = enforcement_level_default
signage = signage_effect_strength if policy_state in ['mandate','recommendation'] else 0
broadcast policy.state, current_enforcement, signage
notes: Enforcement heterogeneity by location sampled at init around default.

modules.name: LocationEnforcement
modules.description: Applies access control and penalties at locations based on current policy and local enforcement.

notes: Penalties add to cost signal used during adoption decision.
Access blocking reduces realized contacts that day.

modules.name: MobilityContact
modules.description: Simulates daily movements to locations and generates contact opportunities and observed norms.

notes: Location norms feed into adoption via signage and enforcement.
Contacts influence exposure proxy metric.

modules.name: MaskMarket
modules.description: Handles mask inventory, restocking, pricing, and sales triggered by adoption decisions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each type in [cloth, surgical, N95]:
  supply[type] += restock_rate[type]
  price[type] += price_adjust_shortage_sensitivity * max(0, demand[type] - supply[type])
  fulfill purchases up to supply[type]
  supply[type] -= fulfilled
  record observable supply levels
emit purchase_outcomes per person and updated current prices
notes: Supply feasibility enforced by construction.
No rationing unless configured (here: none).

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Computes daily adoption probability and mask type choice, issues purchase requests, and updates wearing state.

notes: Adoption requires successful purchase given supply.
Retention modeled via same utility; fatigue accumulates while wearing and recovers otherwise.
Internal state tracks mask tenure for replacement needs (not stored on Person).

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and computes derived indicators.

notes: Exposure reduction is a proxy: 1 - adoption_rate*mean_efficacy over contacts.
Mean efficacy computed using current mask type shares.

algorithms.WattsStrogatz: Generates small-world networks with given average_degree and rewiring probability.
algorithms.LogitAdoption: Computes adoption/retention probabilities via logistic utility with social, risk, policy, cost, and fatigue components.
algorithms.PoissonContacts: Samples daily contact counts per location type using Poisson distributions.
algorithms.InventoryRestock: Updates inventory with fixed daily restock and adjusts prices with shortage-sensitive rule.
algorithms.PolicyScheduler: Applies policy changes on specified days and computes daily enforcement and signage effects.
